text:
deploybot: 🚀 Starting build pipeline for release tag v1.12.0-rc3 on staging (commit 9f3b2d6) — jobs: build / unit / integration / lint / e2e. Change window: 22:00-02:00 UTC.
maya: acked, monitoring. will post if anything blocks.
tom: noted — staging still has the hotfix branch pinned? should we unpin for this run?
liam: @tom not yet; i left it pinned to v1.11.9 for the hotfix. planning to unpin post-smoke if all green.
ci-bot: build 1723456789 started on runner-gpu-7 (image: node:18-bundled).
ci-bot: build job finished — status: success (duration 3m 12s). artifacts: frontend.tgz, backend.tar.gz
deploybot: unit tests running (shard 1/3) — ETA ~2m.
maya: if unit tests fail, we should triage fast. @rachel can you stand by for quick patch?
rachel: on standby.
ci-bot: unit tests shard 1/3 failed — 2 failing tests in service-auth.
liam: linking failing test logs: https://ci.internal/builds/1723456789/logs/unit-shard1 — looks like a flake in token expiry test.
tom: can we re-run just the flaky tests? avoids full rollback.
ci-bot: unit tests rerun (shard 1/3) triggered by @tom.
ci-bot: unit tests shard 1/3 passed on rerun. overall unit stage: passed.
deploybot: integration tests starting (DB: pg13, fixture-set v2026-03-18).
ci-bot: lint job started (eslint v8).
ci-bot: lint job failed — 1 error: frontend/src/components/Widget.tsx line 42 — unused var 'tmp'.
rachel: pulling branch to patch lint. small fix, will open a hotpatch PR with minimal change.
maya: can we hold deployment for the lint patch or continue and patch post-release?
liam: opt: hold. This is a source-quality issue that CI enforces — prefer to keep green.
tom: +1 hold. low-risk to patch quickly.
deploybot: hold placed on rollout by maya — gating on lint fix PR merge.
rachel: PR opened: fix/lint/widget-unused-var — https://git.internal/r/redwood/repo/pull/8212 — includes CI skip for unrelated e2e.
ci-bot: PR 8212 triggered pipeline — lint stage only.
ci-bot: lint passed on PR 8212.
rachel: merged PR 8212 (squash).
ci-bot: pipeline for release tag v1.12.0-rc3 resumed.
deploybot: integration tests report: 1 critical failure in search-indexing (timeout 90s).
liam: seeing Redis timeout spikes in staging metrics around the same time — https://metrics.internal/redis/staging.
maya: @eng-infra can you check redis cluster? might be transient.
tom: would prefer to retry integrations once infra stabilizes. if it keeps failing, we'll pin to v1.11.9 and postpone rc3.
ci-bot: integration tests rerun queued (after infra alert cleared).
ci-bot: integration rerun passed. e2e starting (headless chrome).
deploybot: e2e job failed: 3 flaky UI tests (timing) — logs: https://ci.internal/builds/1723456789/logs/e2e
rachel: those tests are known flakes; we have a flaky-tests tag. maybe we should quarantine them to avoid blocking.
liam: quarantine would mask regressions. for RC we should be conservative — either flaky guard + manual approval or unquarantine and fix.
maya: decision needed: quarantine e2e flaky tests for this RC so we can proceed, or hold for fixes and push rc. input?
tom: +quarantine for speed, with a post-release follow-up issue assigned to rachel.
rachel: will file follow-up ticket and schedule fix.
ci-bot: e2e rerun with flaky-tests skipped — passed.
deploybot: pipeline complete for v1.12.0-rc3 on staging — overall: passed (with lint hotpatch & flaky-tests skipped).
maya: releasing notes check: add lint fix and flaky-tests quarantine note under known issues.
liam: also note: integration timeout observed due to Redis spike — add monitoring alerting tweak to postmortem if it repeats.
tom: tagging release candidate in changelog: v1.12.0-rc3 (notes updated) — https://changelog.internal/releases/v1.12.0-rc3
maya: schedule: will proceed with canary tomorrow during change window unless any rollback decision needed overnight.
rachel: thanks all. I pushed the hotfix changelog entry.
deploybot: FYI: leaving staging pinned to v1.12.0-rc3 for now. If we need to rollback, run: `/deploy rollback staging --to-tag v1.11.9`
liam: acknowledged. closing thread unless anyone sees outstanding blockers.
maya: closing — good run, thanks :tada:
